newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday as winter in the U.S. continued to slow down demand, dealers said.
Dealers said SIR20 offer prices were unchanged at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang. They said the price also remained level at 53.25-53.50 fob in Medan and Surabaya.

"I haven't heard of any trading today. The market is still quiet because winter in the U.S. has slowed down the activity there, which automatically affects our market," said one dealer. The United States is Indonesia's major rubber importer.
Dealers said they expected prices to improve this month.
Dealers earlier said they did not wish to sell rubber below the current prices, adding that if prices continued to decline, farmers would be reluctant to tap their rubber trees.
"If this happens, there will be a lack of raw material, and this will of course be detrimental to the buyers themselves because they do need rubber," he said.
Dealers said January high amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,200 rupiah/kg in Bandung, Tangerang and Medan.
